Latest hemoglobin still below normal for this patient? Then flag that report with a follow-up task; if not, don't touch the chart.

Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. answer is {"latest": ..., "still_low": ..., "task_created": ...}. latest is the most recent result, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit); still_low (boolean) is whether it is low; both are null when no result was ever low. Only when still_low is true, create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference and $report with the DiagnosticReport whose basedOn references the ServiceRequest the latest result's basedOn references and whose result lists the latest result: {"resourceType": "Task", "status": "requested", "intent": "order", "for": {"reference": "$patient"}, "focus": {"reference": "$report"}}. task_created (boolean) is whether you created it. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the latest result, and its DiagnosticReport when you create the Task; when no result was ever low, every hemoglobin result considered), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.

Context: patient MRN SYN-8d8140bce1 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2023-03-16, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The pending order is the ServiceRequest with status active, coded LOINC 4548-4, 2160-0 or 3016-3 and authored on or before the as-of date, that no DiagnosticReport is based on. Its clinic is the organization of the PractitionerRole whose practitioner is that order's requester. answer is {"order_code": ..., "ordered": ...}: order_code (string: the order's first code.coding code) and ordered (its authoredOn date, YYYY-MM-DD). Create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $clinic with that Organization and $order with the order: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$clinic"}], "about": [{"reference": "$order"}]}. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the order, the PractitionerRole and the Organization), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.
